india_invested.summary:
* **CYIENTDLM (CYIENTDLM)** - Stock surged 12.82% to ₹976.25 on September 8, 2026, ahead of a scheduled investor meeting on September 11, 2026.
* **EPACKPEB (EPACKPEB)** - Announced a ₹160 crore manufacturing expansion plan spanning facilities in Ghiloth, Mambattu, and Gujarat.
* **GNG Electronics Limited (EBGNG)** - Stock price rose 7.44% to ₹665.15 on September 8, 2026.
* **KMEW (KMEW)** - Board approved raising up to ₹500 crore via NCDs and approved a stock split reducing share face value from ₹5 to ₹1.
* **KRISHNADEF (KRISHNADEF)** - Share price rose 4.24% to ₹1,111.60 on September 8, 2026.
* **LAURUSLABS (LAURUSLABS)** - Stock rose 3.75% to ₹1,946.90 on September 8, 2026.
* **NH (NH)** - Released quarterly results on September 8, 2026.
* **SAKAR (SAKAR)** - Share price increased by 4.39% to close at ₹1,157.85 on September 8, 2026.
* **SANSERA (SANSERA)** - Stock rose ~3.3% following a foreign brokerage initiating coverage with an 'outperform' rating and Rs 4,954 target price.
* **TANFACIND (TANFACIND)** - Anupam Rasayan is set to acquire a 0.73% stake in Tanfac Industries for ₹60.88 crore through a preferential issue.
* **TDPOWERSYS (TDPOWERSYS)** - Stock rose ~4.5% to ₹768 on September 8, 2026, ahead of a September 10 EGM to vote on promoter and QIP issuance authorities.
* **VENUSPIPES (VENUSPIPES)** - Stock closed 8.00% higher at ₹1,950 on September 8, 2026.
* **STLTECH (STLTECH)** - Shares hit a third consecutive upper circuit at ₹825.60 after Nuvama raised its price target to ₹1,100 based on its "Lakshya" roadmap.
* **UFBL (UFBL)** - Stock closed up 3.39% at ₹715 on September 8, 2026.
* **SFL (SFL)** - Stock rose 5.73% to ₹678.20 on September 8, 2026, India Ratings reaffirmed its IND AA/Stable credit rating, and reports highlighted market competition from Wakefit.

us_invested.summary:
* **Hims & Hers Health, Inc. (HIMS)** - Faces a class action lawsuit alleging privacy and billing issues as analysts weigh growth momentum against margin pressures.
* **JNJ (JNJ)** - Announced 24 neuropsychiatry abstracts ahead of Psych Congress and is presenting at the Wells Fargo Healthcare Conference.
* **KRYS (KRYS)** - Management is scheduled to participate in a fireside chat at the Cantor Global Healthcare Conference on September 10.
* **META (META)** - Launched its "Muse" AI agent, agreed to an $18 billion legal settlement, and drew scrutiny over AI guardrail bypasses and content moderation.
* **NTRA (NTRA)** - Rothschild Redburn initiated coverage with a Buy rating ($385 PT), while major institutions including the Saudi Central Bank increased positions.
* **ORCL (ORCL)** - Shares rallied 4.6% on AI cloud demand ahead of September 10 earnings, drawing bullish price target updates from Citi ($330) and Morgan Stanley ($210).
* **uniQure (QURE)** - Simply Wall St reported the stock may be 36% undervalued post-AMT-130 FDA filing despite a 7% decline over the past week.
* **RKLB (RKLB)** - Stifel issued a $150 price target as the company announced the production release of its IMM Apex solar cells.
* **TWST (TWST)** - Leadership is scheduled to present at the Morgan Stanley Global Healthcare Conference and attend the RNA World Conference.
* **ZS (ZS)** - Shares dropped 4.6% ahead of the Agentic SecOps product launch and executive presentations at Citi and Goldman Sachs conferences.
* **ASE Technology Holding Co., Ltd. (ASX)** - Stock rose 7.14% to close at $40.19 on September 8.
* **RGEN (RGEN)** - The HSR waiting period expired for the BioLife Solutions merger ahead of presentations at the Wells Fargo Healthcare Conference and Process Intensification Summit.
* **AMKR (AMKR)** - Shares gained 6.2% after announcing Phase 2 of its Arizona campus expansion, bringing total investment to approximately $12 billion.
* **AVGO (AVGO)** - Shares rallied on reports of Intel CPU price hikes as CEO Hock Tan highlighted strong AI demand and power constraints at a Goldman Sachs event.
* **GEV (GEV)** - Stock rose 3.24% on September 8.
* **CLPT (CLPT)** - Stock price fell 10.23% over the prior week.
* **Celestica Inc. (CLS)** - Shares rose 5.6% after scheduling its 2026 Investor Day for October 27 and seeing a new position disclosed by Readystate Asset Management.
